text:
Alex: Heads-up — prepping release v2.4.1 for 2026-03-24 23:00 UTC. Drafted release notes + internal copy in gist. Need ops + comms sign-off.
Maria: Link pls? APAC prefers earlier window if possible.
Alex: https://gist.github.com/redwood/rel-2.4.1-copy
Lee: Quick check — pin runtime to 2.4.1-rt? If not pinned autoscaler might flip to 2.5.
Alex: Yes. We will set --pin-version=2.4.1 and model revision=2026-03-15 in deploy params.
Sam: Suggest rollback criteria: 5m error rate > 1% OR p95 latency +200ms over baseline for 10m -> rollback.
Jordan: Agreed. Add synthetic hit to /health/generate in smoke tests and hook metric alerts.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Canary slot reserved 2026-03-24T23:00Z. Canary traffic=5%. Alert hooks: ops-oncall, runbook: https://runbooks.internal/release-2.4.1
Maria: Internal blurb draft: "Staged rollout tonight: infra perf + reliability fixes. Graceful fallback to prior stable if user impact." Can we soften the language?
Alex: I'll soften it to: "staged rollout with automatic fallback to the previous stable version to minimize user impact." Final will go to /internal/snippets.
Lee: Who owns rollback ops? ops-oncall + Sam? Any DB schema owner if migration needed?
Sam: I'm primary for rollback. Jordan backup. Lee will own DB migration runbook and gate.
Alex: Comms please approve by 18:00 UTC today. If no reply we'll use default copy.
Maria: Approved :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: deploy params set --pin-version=2.4.1 --canary=5 --auto-rollback=false. To enable auto-rollback set --auto-rollback=true.
Jordan: Adding kv-cache warmup to smoke to avoid p95 spike during canary.
Alex: Thanks everyone — I'll post final internal announce and pin the RN. I'll ping when canary starts.
